newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Meralco unit says H1 net 298.48 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Meralco unit says H1 net 298.48 mln pesos.

text.p: Rockwell Land Corp, a unit of the Manila Electric Corp (Meralco), said on Thursday it posted a net income of 298.48 million pesos in the first six months of the year.
No comparative figures were given by the company.
The company's revenues amounted to 1.21 billion pesos in the first half of the year while its cost and expenses totalled 839.86 million pesos.
Rockwell Land was set up two years ago to develop a 15.5-hectare site in the financial district of Makati into a mixed-use commercial and residential centre.
Meralco has a 70 percent stake in the 22-billion peso Rockwell project.
Other shareholders of Rockwell Land are Benpres Holdings Corp and First Philippine Holdings Corp.
